1.consolidated_definition: Objeto o fenómeno observado en el cielo y cuya naturaleza se desconoce. Sigla anglicada, poco frecuente. Véase ovni. Vigilia UFO en Puerto Rico. Puerto Rico vuelve a hacer historia a nivel local e internacional... y al parecer fuera del planeta. Y es que Lajas albergará este próximo sábado, 30 de junio, una actividad para conmemorar el Día Nacional de Ovnis en la que se espera la participación de varios países (Al rojo vivo, PR, consultado 20-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Object or phenomenon observed in the sky whose nature is unknown. Anglicized abbreviation, infrequently used. See UFO. Vigilia UFO in Puerto Rico. Puerto Rico will make history at local and international levels... and apparently beyond the planet. It is that Lajas will host this upcoming Saturday, June 30, an activity to commemorate National UFO Day, in which participation from several countries is expected (Al rojo vivo, PR, consulted October 20, 2008). 

Object or phenomenon observed in the sky whose nature is unknown; often referred to as a UFO.
